scope: Read source passages, not merely HTTP availability. These are source notes for original lessons, not permission to reproduce complete articles. Historical product posts never establish current availability, pricing or accuracy. Dates omitted below were not reliably published on the source page.

sources.title: Introducing: Be My AI
sources.locator: How to Use Be My AI
sources.facts: The 2023 announcement describes taking a photo, receiving a description, and asking further questions. A human volunteer remains available when the description is insufficient or needs checking.
sources.limits: A historical vendor announcement for blind and low-vision users; not independent accuracy evidence or a promise of present-day availability. No actual user transcript was inspected.
sources.factsZh: 2023年的公告描述了拍摄照片、获取描述并提出进一步问题的过程。当描述不够充分或需要核查时，仍有人类志愿者可供协助。
sources.limitsZh: 这是一份面向盲人及低视力用户的历史厂商公告；它既非独立的准确性证据，也不构成对当前可用性的承诺。并未查验真实的用户记录。
sources.locatorZh: 如何使用 Be My AI

sources.title: Apollo 8 Astronaut Bill Anders Captures Earthrise
sources.locator: Image and caption; image credit NASA
sources.facts: The photograph was taken on December 24, 1968, during Apollo 8's lunar orbit, by Bill Anders. NASA's article was published December 23, 2022. Its caption does not describe a Moon landing. The image shows Earth above the lunar horizon.
sources.limits: The image alone does not establish its date or photographer. Those facts come from the accompanying record. The historical photograph is not AI-generated.
sources.factsZh: 该照片由比尔·安德斯（Bill Anders）于1968年12月24日阿波罗8号绕月飞行期间拍摄。NASA的文章发表于2022年12月23日。其图片说明并未描述登月。画面展示了月球地平线之上的地球。
sources.limitsZh: 仅凭图像本身无法确定其拍摄日期或摄影师，这些事实来自随附的文字记录。该历史照片并非由AI生成。
sources.locatorZh: 图像与图片说明；图片来源：NASA

sources.title: Introducing canvas
sources.locator: A new way to work with ChatGPT; writing features
sources.facts: The launch described working beside a writing draft, selecting passages for targeted feedback, making direct edits and restoring earlier versions.
sources.limits: Historical launch features, not a guarantee that every account has the same interface today. The course teaches controlled revision, not a product-specific button sequence.
sources.factsZh: 发布内容描述了在写作草稿旁并排工作、选定特定段落以获取针对性反馈、直接进行编辑以及恢复早期版本的功能。
sources.limitsZh: 这些是产品发布时的历史功能，不能保证如今每个账户都拥有完全相同的界面。本课程讲授的是受控修改方法，而非某个特定产品的具体按钮操作顺序。
sources.locatorZh: 与 ChatGPT 协作的新方式；写作功能

sources.title: Introducing ChatGPT search
sources.locator: Go straight to the source
sources.facts: The 2024 launch added web-source links to answers and a source list readers could open. This is a retrieval feature, not proof that every linked passage supports every sentence.
sources.limits: Historical product announcement. Availability and interface changes are outside this lesson; a citation must still be opened and checked.
sources.factsZh: 2024年的发布在回答中加入了网络信源链接，并提供了读者可点击打开的来源列表。这属于信息检索功能，并不证明所链接的每个段落都能支持回答中的每一句话。
sources.limitsZh: 这是历史产品公告。功能的可用性与界面的后续变化不在本课讨论范围内；引用的来源仍必须由读者亲自打开并核对。
sources.locatorZh: 直达来源

sources.title: Introducing Whisper
sources.locator: Speech recognition introduction
sources.facts: Whisper was introduced as a speech-recognition system that can transcribe speech and translate speech from other languages into English.
sources.limits: Speech recognition is not a guarantee of a correct transcript, speaker intent or factual truth. Do not invent a recording, transcript or error that the source does not show.
sources.factsZh: Whisper作为一款语音识别系统推出，能够转录语音，并将其他语言的语音翻译为英语。
sources.limitsZh: 语音识别并不能保证转录文本完全正确，也不能保证体现说话者的真实意图或事实真相。切勿虚构原始材料中未体现的录音、转录文本或错误。
sources.locatorZh: 语音识别简介

sources.title: Sycophancy in GPT-4o: what happened and what we’re doing about it
sources.locator: Rollback explanation
sources.facts: OpenAI rolled back a GPT-4o update after it became overly agreeable and flattering. The post describes a specific deployment incident.
sources.limits: Not a statement about every current model. No invented examples of the affected model's answers; practice comparisons must be labeled editorial exercises.
sources.factsZh: 在一次更新导致其表现出过度顺从与奉承后，OpenAI回滚了GPT-4o的该次更新。该文描述了一起具体的系统部署事件。
sources.limitsZh: 这并非对当前所有模型的定论。切勿虚构受影响模型的回答示例；练习中的对比必须标明为教学编辑练习。
sources.locatorZh: 回滚说明

sources.title: Why language models hallucinate
sources.locator: Opening example and explanation of guessing incentives
sources.facts: The authors describe asking a widely used chatbot for a researcher's dissertation title and receiving different confident incorrect answers. They distinguish a correct answer from an unsupported guess and discuss evaluation incentives.
sources.limits: Do not invent the wrong titles or identify an unnamed chatbot. The example proves the reported failure, not a universal error rate.
sources.factsZh: 作者描述了向一款广泛使用的聊天机器人询问某位研究人员的博士论文题目，却得到了数个语气笃定但各不相同的错误答案。作者区分了正确答案与毫无依据的猜测，并讨论了评估激励机制。
sources.limitsZh: 切勿虚构错误的论文题目，也不要在文中未指名的情况下指认具体的聊天机器人。该示例仅证实了所报告的那次失败案例，并不代表普遍的错误率。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇示例与猜测动机解释

sources.title: Gemini image generation got it wrong. We'll do better.
sources.locator: What happened
sources.facts: Google paused Gemini's generation of images of people after inaccurate and offensive results. Its explanation distinguished the conversational app from Search and the underlying models.
sources.limits: A historical product incident, not evidence that all present image tools fail in the same way. No generated image from that incident is republished.
sources.factsZh: 在生成了不准确且具有冒犯性的结果后，谷歌暂停了Gemini生成人物图像的功能。其官方解释将该对话式应用与谷歌搜索以及底层模型区分开来。
sources.limitsZh: 这是一起历史产品事件，并不证明当前所有图像工具都会以同样的方式出错。并未重新发布该事件中生成的任何图像。
sources.locatorZh: 事件经过

sources.title: Introducing NotebookLM
sources.locator: Source grounding and citations
sources.facts: The initial NotebookLM experiment used documents selected by the user to support summaries, questions and ideas, with citations back to material. The announcement still recommended fact-checking.
sources.limits: Grounding narrows the material; it does not certify accuracy. Product names and interfaces have since changed.
sources.factsZh: 最初的NotebookLM实验版本利用用户选定的文档，帮助做摘要、提问和构思，并提供回到原材料的引用。公告仍建议核对事实。
sources.limitsZh: 选定资料可以缩小参考范围，不能保证每个结论正确；这是2023年的产品介绍，不说明今天所有界面和功能。
sources.locatorZh: 选定资料与引用说明

sources.title: Prompt engineering best practices for ChatGPT
sources.locator: Be clear and specific; iterative refinement
sources.facts: The guidance recommends clear requests, relevant context, an explicit tone when needed, and reviewing and refining the result.
sources.limits: Guidance, not an experiment proving a guaranteed productivity gain. No special phrase guarantees correctness.
sources.factsZh: 该指南建议提出清晰具体的请求、提供相关的背景信息、在需要时明确指定语气，并对生成的结果进行审查和优化。
sources.limitsZh: 这属于指导建议，并非证明必然能提高生产力的实证实验。没有任何特定的提示词能够保证结果绝对正确。
sources.locatorZh: 表达清晰具体；迭代优化

sources.title: Introducing ChatGPT agent
sources.locator: User control and safeguards
sources.facts: The launch described an assistant that could browse and take actions, with confirmations for consequential actions, interruption and user takeover. It also discussed malicious instructions inside material the agent encounters.
sources.limits: Historical design description, not a guarantee of perfect safety. The lesson does not execute an agent or ask users to connect private accounts. The inspected launch page explicitly labels itself outdated; use it as the 2025 design record, not as current product availability or a guarantee for every assistant.
sources.factsZh: 2025年的发布说明介绍了一款可以浏览并执行动作的助手，包含重要动作确认、中断与接管，也讨论了外部材料中的恶意指令。
sources.limitsZh: 这是2025年的设计记录，页面现已标明过时。它不证明当前每个助手都具备这些控制，也不是绝对安全的保证。
sources.locatorZh: 用户控制与安全保障

sources.title: Temporary Chat FAQ
sources.locator: Personalization, history, retention and third-party actions
sources.facts: As inspected September 15, 2026, temporary chats do not create new memories or appear in history unless saved. Personalized temporary chats can still use existing memories and instructions. Third-party actions have their own data handling; a temporary conversation is not a promise that no information is used or retained.
sources.limits: Frequently changing settings. Do not repeat the older claim that Temporary Chat can never use existing memories. Teach reading the actual selected controls, not memorizing an old interface.
sources.factsZh: 截至2026年9月15日查验时，临时聊天不会创建新的记忆，除非主动保存，否则也不会出现在历史记录中。开启个性化的临时聊天仍可使用现有的记忆和指令。第三方操作有其自身的数据处理机制；临时对话并不意味着完全不使用或不保留任何信息。
sources.limitsZh: 相关设置变动频繁。切勿再重复“临时聊天绝不会使用既有记忆”的过时说法。应教会学员看清当前实际勾选的控制选项，而不是死记旧界面的样子。
sources.locatorZh: 个性化、历史记录、数据留存与第三方操作

sources.title: File storage and Library in ChatGPT
sources.locator: File storage and reuse
sources.facts: The inspected documentation treats uploaded and created files as reusable Library items and excludes Temporary Chat uploads from Library storage.
sources.limits: Account capabilities can vary. Deleting a conversation and managing a saved file are distinct actions; do not infer storage deletion from hiding a chat.
sources.factsZh: 查验的文档将上传和创建的文件视为可重复使用的“资源库”（Library）项目，并将临时聊天中上传的文件排除在资源库存储之外。
sources.limitsZh: 不同账户的功能权限可能有所不同。删除对话与管理已保存的文件是两种不同的操作；切勿仅仅因为隐藏了聊天就推断存储中的文件已被删除。
sources.locatorZh: 文件存储与复用

sources.title: Data analysis with ChatGPT
sources.locator: Preparing spreadsheets; checking analysis
sources.facts: The documentation recommends clear column names and one record per row, specifying the desired calculation or grouping, and inspecting analysis instead of accepting a chart at face value.
sources.limits: A capability description, not verification of any particular result. Use small supplied tables and explicit arithmetic; do not claim we ran a tool that was not run.
sources.factsZh: 文档建议：设置清晰的列名且每行记录一条数据，明确指定所需的计算或分组方式，并审查分析过程而不是对其生成的图表全盘接受。
sources.limitsZh: 这只是对功能特性的说明，并非对任何特定计算结果的验证。教学中应使用提供的小型表格并进行明确的算术推导；未曾运行过的工具切勿声称已经运行。
sources.locatorZh: 准备电子表格；核查分析结果

sources.title: File Uploads FAQ
sources.locator: Synthesis, transformation and extraction
sources.facts: The documentation distinguishes combining information, transforming a document's presentation, and extracting requested information from files.
sources.limits: Formats and limits depend on the account and product. Uploading a file does not prove that every page or embedded image was correctly interpreted.
sources.factsZh: 文档区分了三种操作：综合信息、转换文档的呈现形式，以及从文件中提取所需信息。
sources.limitsZh: 支持的文件格式和限制取决于具体账户和产品。上传了文件并不证明其中的每一页或内嵌图像都被正确解析了。
sources.locatorZh: 信息综合、转换与提取

sources.title: Create Audio Overviews in Gemini Notebook
sources.locator: AI-generated audio and limitations
sources.facts: The feature produces an audio discussion based on supplied material using AI-generated voices. The help page warns that it can contain inaccuracies or audio glitches.
sources.limits: Generated hosts are not people who conducted an interview. The NotebookLM address redirected to Gemini Notebook when inspected; no stable button sequence is promised.
sources.factsZh: 该功能使用AI生成的声音，基于提供的材料生成音频讨论。帮助页面警告称，音频中可能包含不准确之处或声音瑕疵。
sources.limitsZh: 生成的播客主持人并非实际进行采访的真人。查验时NotebookLM的网址已重定向至Gemini Notebook；无法保证界面的按钮操作顺序长期保持不变。
sources.locatorZh: AI生成的音频及其局限性

sources.title: Harnessing GPT-4 so that all students benefit. A nonprofit approach for equal access
sources.locator: Khanmigo pilot and tutoring examples
sources.facts: Khan Academy introduced a pilot tutor that guides learners with questions and hints rather than simply giving every answer, and noted possible errors.
sources.limits: A pilot's design intent, not proof that all AI tutors improve learning. Do not reproduce the article's sweeping claims about what nobody can learn.
sources.factsZh: 可汗学院（Khan Academy）推出了一款试点导师，该工具通过提问和提示来引导学习者，而不是直接给出所有答案，并指出了可能存在错误。
sources.limitsZh: 这只是试点项目的设计初衷，并非证明所有AI辅导工具都能提升学习效果的证据。切勿照搬原文中关于“谁也学不会某些内容”等一概而论的断言。
sources.locatorZh: Khanmigo试点项目与辅导示例

sources.title: Spacing and retrieval: Example of practice
sources.locator: Spacing and retrieval in the French classroom
sources.facts: A published Year 7–8 French teaching example separates vocabulary into sets, revisits prior words and uses low-stakes quizzes before combining those words into more complex sentences.
sources.limits: A reported school teaching practice, not a controlled University adult-user trial or a guarantee of retention.
sources.factsZh: 一份公开发表的7–8年级法语教学实例展示了：将词汇分组、复习旧单词，并在将这些词汇组合成更复杂的句子之前使用低风险的小测验。
sources.limitsZh: 这是中小学法语课堂中的公开教学实践，不是对University成人用户做的对照实验，不能直接保证这里的学习效果。
sources.locatorZh: 法语课堂中的间隔重复与检索练习

sources.title: Explicit instruction practice guide
sources.locator: Worked examples and guided practice
sources.facts: The guide recommends explaining a worked example, introducing manageable new elements and gradually removing guidance as learners practice independently.
sources.limits: Education guidance whose context must be considered. An AI-generated explanation is not itself a measured learning outcome.
sources.factsZh: 该指南建议讲解详细的样例，循序渐进地引入可掌控的新知识点，并在学习者独立练习的过程中逐步减少指导。
sources.limitsZh: 这是需要结合具体应用背景考量的教育指导。AI生成的讲解本身并不等于经过衡量的实际学习成果。
sources.locatorZh: 样例讲解与引导式练习

sources.title: Informative Images
sources.locator: Examples 2 and 3: dog with a bell; bottle-cap instructions
sources.facts: The actual tutorial contrasts a picture description with text that communicates the needed information. Its dog example focuses on a bell on the collar; its cap example communicates the required turning direction.
sources.limits: Published instructional examples, not an AI product trial. No claim that a generated image description automatically meets accessibility requirements.
sources.factsZh: 该实际教程将单纯的图片外观描述与传达必要信息的文本进行了对比。其中的小狗示例侧重于项圈上的铃铛；瓶盖示例则传达了所需的旋转方向。
sources.limitsZh: 这是公开发布的教学示例，并非AI产品的测试实验。并不声称生成的图像描述能自动符合无障碍访问要求。
sources.locatorZh: 示例2与3：戴铃铛的狗；瓶盖说明

sources.title: Functional Images
sources.locator: Examples 4 and 5: print and search controls
sources.facts: The actual examples label an icon by its action: printing a page or starting a search, rather than merely naming a printer or magnifying glass.
sources.limits: A communication principle illustrated by interface examples; beginners do not need to learn HTML for this lesson.
sources.factsZh: 实际示例依据图标对应的操作来进行标注（例如打印页面或发起搜索），而不是仅仅称其为打印机或放大镜。
sources.limitsZh: 这是通过界面示例阐述的沟通原则；初学者学习本课时无需学习HTML。
sources.locatorZh: 示例4与5：打印与搜索控件

sources.title: Writing for Web Accessibility
sources.locator: Clear and concise content; meaningful headings and links
sources.facts: The guidance uses meaningful headings and link text, clear instructions and concise wording to help readers find and understand information.
sources.limits: Writing guidance, not a blanket rule that the shortest version is best. Keep necessary conditions, dates and actions intact.
sources.factsZh: 该指南倡导使用有明确含义的标题与链接文本、清晰的说明以及简明扼要的措辞，帮助读者查找和理解信息。
sources.limitsZh: 这属于写作建议，并非一概而论地认为“篇幅越短越好”。必须保持必要的条件、日期和具体操作完整无缺。
sources.locatorZh: 清晰简明的内容；有意义的标题与链接

sources.title: NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines
sources.locator: Educational and informational uses; third-party material; endorsements
sources.facts: NASA permits many factual educational uses of its media with credit, while distinguishing third-party copyrights, protected marks and endorsement restrictions.
sources.limits: Not every image on a NASA page is necessarily NASA-owned. This does not grant a right to use the NASA logo to imply endorsement of University.
sources.factsZh: NASA允许在注明来源的情况下将其媒体素材用于许多客观事实性的教育用途，但明确区分了第三方版权、受保护的商标以及代言背书方面的限制。
sources.limitsZh: NASA网页上的每张图片不一定都由NASA拥有。相关许可不允许使用标识暗示NASA认可或代言University。
sources.locatorZh: 教育与信息用途；第三方素材；代言背书

sources.title: Smithsonian Releases 2.8 Million Free Images for Broader Public Use
sources.locator: Open Access launch announcement
sources.facts: The Smithsonian announced an Open Access collection that people could download, transform and share. The release concerned designated open-access items, not every image found online.
sources.limits: Historical launch count, not today's collection size. Check the individual item and any other rights before reuse; this lesson links to the announcement, not a copied collection.
sources.factsZh: 史密森尼学会（Smithsonian）宣布推出开放获取（Open Access）馆藏，供人们下载、改编和分享。该发布仅针对指定的开放获取项目，并非指网络上能找到的每一张图片。
sources.limitsZh: 发布时的数据属于历史数据，并不代表今天的馆藏规模。重新使用前请务必核对单件物品的具体状态及其他潜在权利；本课仅链接至该发布公告，并非复制了整个馆藏。
sources.locatorZh: 开放获取发布公告

sources.title: Celebrate International Observe the Moon Night at NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center
sources.locator: Opening invitation and participation information
sources.facts: The historical announcement invited the public to Goddard's Visitor Center in Greenbelt, Maryland, on October 21, 2023, from 6 to 9 p.m. EDT, rain or shine. No registration was needed. Activities included eclipse art, space rocks, Moon phases using cookies, and a lunar-lander design activity.
sources.limits: Past event, not an invitation to attend now. A rewritten invitation in this course is an editorial exercise, not a NASA-approved notice. Never convert EDT without a specified destination zone.
sources.factsZh: 这份历史公告邀请公众于2023年10月21日美国东部夏令时间（EDT）晚6点至9点，前往马里兰州格林贝尔特的戈达德游客中心参加活动，风雨无阻，无需报名。活动内容包括日食艺术创作、太空岩石展示、用饼干演示月相以及月球着陆器设计活动。
sources.limitsZh: 这是已经过去的过往活动，并非当前的活动邀请。本课程中重写的邀请函属于教学编辑练习，并非NASA官方批准的通知。在未指定目标时区的情况下，绝不可直接换算EDT时间。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇邀请与参与信息

sources.title: Celebrate ‘International Observe the Moon Night’ with NASA
sources.locator: Opening date and how to participate
sources.facts: This separate historical announcement was for October 1, 2022. Participation could be in person, virtual or hybrid.
sources.limits: A different year's event. Combining its date with the 2023 announcement would create a nonexistent notice.
sources.factsZh: 这是另一份单独的历史公告，针对的是2022年10月1日的活动。参与形式包括现场参与、线上参与或线上线下混合形式。
sources.limitsZh: 这是另一年份的活动。若将其日期与2023年的公告混在一起，会拼凑出一份根本不存在的虚假通知。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇活动日期与参与方式

sources.title: Host An International Observe the Moon Night Event
sources.locator: Audience and setting; Moon visibility; promotion; evaluation
sources.facts: The hosting guide asks organizers to decide audience and setting, check local Moon visibility, plan for rain or clouds, arrange help and collect feedback. It offers online or indoor alternatives to direct viewing.
sources.limits: Planning guidance, not approval of a learner's event or a live weather forecast. Local permissions and visibility must be checked independently.
sources.factsZh: 主办指南要求组织者确定受众与场地设置、查看当地月球可见情况、针对阴雨多云做好备用预案、安排现场人手并收集反馈。指南还提供了替代直接室外观测的线上或室内方案。
sources.limitsZh: 这属于策划指导，并非对学员所办活动的官方批准，也不是实时天气预报。当地的场地许可和观测可见度必须自行独立核实。
sources.locatorZh: 受众与场地设置；月球可见度；宣传推广；效果评估

sources.title: Trip Planning Guide
sources.locator: Know Before You Go
sources.facts: The guide treats planning as preparation for a specific park and activity and explains that its day/overnight scope does not cover all additional preparation needed for multi-day backcountry trips.
sources.limits: A source-scoping exercise, not personalized outdoor safety advice or proof that a route is currently open.
sources.factsZh: 指南要求按具体公园和活动做准备；它说明了日间及过夜出行的范围，不包含完整多日野外行程所需的全部额外准备。
sources.limitsZh: 这属于界定信息源适用范围的练习，并非针对个人的户外安全建议，也不能证明某条路线目前处于开放状态。
sources.locatorZh: 行前须知（Know Before You Go）

sources.title: Ten Essentials
sources.locator: Opening scope and navigation category
sources.facts: The National Park Service organizes essentials into categories and says additional equipment may be needed for the particular activity. It advises checking the park and telling someone the intended trip and return time.
sources.limits: A basic list is not a complete safety guarantee. Lessons focus on organizing and checking information, not recommending a real trip.
sources.factsZh: 美国国家公园管理局（National Park Service）将必备物品按类别进行整理，并说明具体活动可能需要额外的装备。它建议提前查询公园信息，并将计划行程与预计返回时间告知他人。
sources.limitsZh: 基础物品清单并不能构成绝对的安全保障。本课重点在于组织和核对信息，并非推荐学员进行实际的出行。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇适用范围与导航类别

sources.title: Fighting back against harmful voice cloning
sources.locator: Consumer warning and independent callback advice, before the comments
sources.facts: The FTC describes scammers using cloned voices to make supposed family emergencies or boss requests more believable. It advises verifying through a phone number already known to belong to the person, or contacting another family member or friend when the person cannot be reached.
sources.limits: This is a public consumer warning and protective advice, not a recorded call or a controlled accuracy study. No victim identity, voice sample or claimed loss amount is invented. User comments are not the FTC guidance.
sources.factsZh: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）描述了诈骗分子利用克隆声音让所谓的家庭紧急情况或领导要求显得更加逼真。该机构建议通过此前已知属于当事人的电话号码进行核实，如果联系不上本人，则联系其他家人或朋友。
sources.limitsZh: 这是面向公众的消费者警示与防范建议，并非真实的通话录音，也不是受控的准确性研究。切勿虚构受害者身份、声音样本或声称的损失金额。网页下方的用户评论不属于FTC的官方指导意见。
sources.locatorZh: 评论区前的消费者警示与独立回拨建议

sources.title: 2024 National Book Festival
sources.locator: Opening event description and Watch the Author Talks
sources.facts: The historical page gives August 24, 2024, Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, D.C., 9 a.m.–8 p.m. with doors at 8:30 a.m., free public attendance. It announces selected livestreams and says all program videos will be available afterward.
sources.limits: This is a historical announcement, not a current invitation. Selected livestreams do not mean every session was live; free attendance does not promise books, parking, food or travel. Every promised recording was not individually checked. University editorial practice is not an official Library of Congress notice.
sources.factsZh: 页面记录的活动日期是2024年8月24日，地点为华盛顿特区Walter E. Washington Convention Center，活动时间9:00至20:00，8:30开放入场。页面说明免费向公众开放，部分节目安排直播，并说明所有节目录像将于会后提供。
sources.limitsZh: 这是历史活动页面，不是现在的邀请。部分节目直播不等于全部直播；免费入场不等于图书、停车、交通或餐饮免费。这里未逐一核验全部会后录像是否实际可访问。University的改写不代表国会图书馆的官方通知。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇活动介绍与“观看作者讲座”（Watch the Author Talks）

sources.title: Smithsonian Open Access at One Year: What Have People Created?
sources.locator: Opening three paragraphs: collection size and 2020 usage
sources.facts: At its first anniversary the program reported more than 3.2 million digital collection images. It separately reported more than 35 million views and 1.7 million downloads of Open Access content in 2020. These describe different quantities and periods, not three estimates of the same audience.
sources.limits: A first-party historical report. More than is a lower-bound qualifier, not an exact count. Downloads or views are not unique people. It does not report a visitor-to-download conversion rate or prove that the program caused a particular learning outcome.
sources.factsZh: 在该项目一周年之际，报告显示数字馆藏图像超过320万件。另外单独报告了2020年开放获取内容获得超过3500万次浏览和170万次下载。这些数据描述的是不同的统计量和时间段，并非对同一受众群体的三次不同估算。
sources.limitsZh: 这是第一方的历史报告。“超过”是一个下限限定词，而非精确数字。下载量或浏览量并不等同于独立访客人数。报告并未体现访客到下载的转化率，也无法证明该项目促成了某种特定的学习成果。
sources.locatorZh: 开篇前三段：馆藏规模与2020年使用情况

sources.title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland — Chapter I, Down the Rabbit-Hole
sources.publisher: Project Gutenberg; original work by Lewis Carroll
sources.locator: Chapter I, opening paragraphs through the White Rabbit taking out its watch
sources.facts: The actual opening has Alice sitting beside her sister on a bank, looking at a book without pictures or conversations, considering picking daisies, and noticing a White Rabbit. The long third paragraph distinguishes hearing it speak from seeing it take a watch out of a waistcoat-pocket; the latter makes Alice get up and follow it. The source text can be inspected directly rather than trusting an AI-generated book summary.
sources.limits: A real published literary text whose story is fiction, not a report that rabbits speak. Use only a short opening passage for reading exercises; do not invent later plot as part of that passage. University Chinese explanations are original, not copied from a copyrighted translation.
sources.factsZh: 实际的开篇写道：爱丽丝和姐姐坐在河岸边，看着一本没有插图也没有对话的书，正想着要不要去摘雏菊，这时注意到了一只白兔。长篇的第三段将“听到白兔说话”与“看到白兔从背心口袋里掏出怀表”区分开来；正是后者让爱丽丝跳起身来并跟着它跑去。可以直接查阅原文，而无需盲目轻信AI生成的图书摘要。
sources.limitsZh: 这是真实出版的文学文本，其故事情节属于虚构，并非证明兔子真会说话的新闻报道。阅读练习仅使用开篇的一小段；切勿把后续情节虚构成该选段的一部分。University编写的中文讲解均为原创，并非抄袭自享有版权的既有翻译版本。
sources.locatorZh: 第一章，开篇各段至白兔掏出怀表处

sources.title: Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland by Lewis Carroll — eBook record
sources.locator: About this eBook: author, language, eBook number, release/update and copyright fields
sources.facts: The catalog identifies Lewis Carroll, English text, eBook number 11, digital release June 27, 2008, update June 26, 2025, and public-domain status in the USA. Those digital dates are not the original novel's publication date.
sources.limits: Do not use the site's explicitly automatically generated summary as primary evidence for the plot. The catalog's copyright statement is scoped to the USA, not a legal guarantee for every translation, image or country.
sources.factsZh: 图书目录信息标明：作者为刘易斯·卡罗尔（Lewis Carroll），英文文本，电子书编号为11，数字版发布于2008年6月27日，更新于2025年6月26日，且在美国处于公有领域状态。这些数字化日期并非该原版小说的出版日期。
sources.limitsZh: 切勿将网站上明确标为自动生成的摘要作为证实情节的一手依据。目录中的版权声明仅限于美国境内，并非针对每种译本、每张插图或在所有国家都有效的法律保证。
sources.locatorZh: 关于本电子书：作者、语言、电子书编号、发布/更新及版权字段

sources.title: Under the Wave off Kanagawa (The Great Wave)
sources.locator: Object information, image rights label and introductory collection description
sources.facts: The collection identifies Katsushika Hokusai's work, approximately 1830–32, as a woodblock print with ink and color on paper, from Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji. The image is marked Public Domain. Mount Fuji appears as a small triangular shape behind the wave. These are the recorded object's identity and visible composition, not a photograph of a documented storm.
sources.limits: Preserve the approximate date and the distinction between artwork and documentary photograph. Do not turn a title into evidence of an actual disaster. An AI-assisted caption, crop or new illustration is a separate University/learner work, not approved museum copy.
sources.factsZh: 馆藏记录将葛饰北斋这件约1830—1832年的作品标为《富岳三十六景》中的纸本墨与设色木版画，并标明图像属于公有领域。画面中巨浪后方有一个小小的三角形富士山。作品身份来自记录，构图来自实际图像观察。
sources.limitsZh: 创作时间是约略范围；木版画不是一场真实风暴的纪实照片。University或学习者写的图注和改编不是博物馆官方说明或认可。
sources.locatorZh: 藏品信息、图像版权标签及藏品介绍

sources.title: Open Access at The Met
sources.locator: Open Access policy and the public-domain collection image designation
sources.facts: The museum's Open Access policy makes images of public-domain artworks and basic collection data available under Creative Commons Zero. A collection object's rights designation matters; the policy does not make every image on the internet free to reuse.
sources.limits: Check the individual object's Public Domain/Open Access status. Credit the original object and museum as the source while identifying any learner alterations; do not imply endorsement or make a blanket international legal claim.
sources.factsZh: 该博物馆的开放获取（Open Access）政策根据知识共享CC0（Creative Commons Zero）协议，提供公有领域艺术品的图像和基础馆藏数据。具体藏品的权利标识至关重要；该政策并不意味着互联网上的每一张图片都可以免费重复使用。
sources.limitsZh: 请核对单件藏品的公有领域/开放获取具体标识状态。在注明原始藏品及博物馆为来源的同时，应标明学员所做的任何修改；切勿暗示获得了博物馆的认可背书，也不要做出涵盖国际法律的笼统断言。
sources.locatorZh: 开放获取政策与公有领域馆藏图像标识

sources.title: Smithsonian Open Access — Registry of Open Data on AWS
sources.publisher: Smithsonian Institution (SI), dataset manager; AWS Open Data registry
sources.locator: Description, Managed By, License and How to Cite
sources.locatorZh: 资料说明、管理者、许可与引用说明
sources.facts: The SI-managed dataset description records the February 25, 2020 release of over 2.8 million CC0 2-D and 3-D images with related metadata and research data. It separately describes 155 million objects, 2.1 million library volumes and 156,000 cubic feet of archives in its institutional context. It names SI as manager. These are different kinds of quantities, not unique users.
sources.factsZh: 由SI管理的数据集说明记录了2020年2月25日发布超过280万件CC0二维、三维图像及相关元数据和研究数据的事件。它在机构背景中另列1.55亿件物品、210万册图书和15.6万立方英尺档案，并标明管理者为SI。这些数量的对象与单位不同，不是独立使用人数。
sources.limits: The entry has no publication date for the page itself. The release date belongs to the release event; collection-context counts do not all have a separately stated census date. Do not add unlike quantities, infer digitization percentages or label downloads/users with these counts. CC0 applies to the described dataset, not everything online.
sources.limitsZh: 条目未给页面自身的发布日期。2020年日期属于发布事件；机构背景中的馆藏数没有逐项独立统计日期。不能把不同单位相加、推算数字化比例，或把这些数量写成下载量与人数。CC0说明针对所述数据集，不是网络上全部内容。

sources.title: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.locator: Opening description and Featured Platforms
sources.locatorZh: 开篇介绍与特色平台
sources.facts: On the recorded access date, the public project page describes access to more than 5.1 million 2D and 3D digital items. It offers search, usage statistics, 3D Voyager, Learning Lab and research-data entry points. It does not state a unique-user count or an exact inventory total.
sources.factsZh: 在所记录的查看日期，公开项目页说明可以访问超过510万件二维、三维数字项目，并提供搜索、使用统计、三维查看器、学习实验室和研究数据等入口。该段没有给出独立用户数或精确库存总数。
sources.limits: A living page checked on 2026-09-15, not a statement that the number will stay unchanged or that all images found online are reusable. Digital items, objects, downloads and people are not interchangeable. This is not a controlled outcome study.
sources.limitsZh: 这是2026年9月15日查阅的动态页面，不代表数字以后不变，也不代表网上所有图像都能直接使用。数字项目、实物、下载动作和人不能互相替换。这不是学习效果的对照实验。

translationReview.scope: All 36 translated notes read against their English fact boundaries. Clarified announcement versus fulfillment for LOC recordings, public-domain scope, historical agent availability, artwork medium and beginner wording.
